have : ContinuousOn (fun x : B × F ↦ a.coordChange he' he x.1 x.2)
          ((e'.baseSet ∩ e.baseSet) ×ˢ univ) :=
        isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.comp_continuousOn
          ((a.continuousOn_coordChange he' he).prodMap continuousOn_id)
findings.problem: Both `toFiberBundleCore` (lines 594-596) and `toFiberPrebundle` (lines 872-875) manually prove continuity of `(b, v) ↦ γ b v` by composing `isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous` with `ContinuousOn.prodMap`. This is exactly the imported `ContinuousOn.clm_apply` lemma, whose proof is the same bounded-bilinear-map composition. The implementation repeats both the evaluation-continuity argument and the `s ×ˢ univ` domain bookkeeping in two constructions.
findings.proposed_change:
Use `ContinuousOn.clm_apply` in both places after precomposing the CLM-valued map with `Prod.fst`. For example, add a shared wrapper

```lean
private lemma ContinuousOn.clm_apply_fst {f : B → F →L[R] F} {s : Set B}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f s) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : B × F => f p.1 p.2) (s ×ˢ univ) := by
  exact ((hf.comp' continuousOn_fst (by
    rintro ⟨b, v⟩ ⟨hb, -⟩
    exact hb)).clm_apply continuous_snd.continuousOn)
```

Then the core proof becomes `(Z.continuousOn_coordChange i j).clm_apply_fst`, and the prebundle proof becomes `(a.continuousOn_coordChange he' he).clm_apply_fst`.
findings.benefit: Both fiber-bundle-core and vector-prebundle constructions would use one standard evaluation-continuity lemma instead of duplicating the internals of bounded bilinear evaluation. This makes the domain conversion reusable and keeps the two construction paths aligned with the normed-operator API.

theorem ContinuousOn.clm_apply {f : X → E →L[𝕜] F} {g : X → E}
    {s : Set X} (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (hg : ContinuousOn g s) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ f x (g x)) s :=
  (isBoundedBilinearMap_apply (𝕜 := 𝕜) (F := F)).continuous.comp_continuousOn (hf.prodMk hg)

findings.proposed_change:
Reuse the already defined `continuousLinearMapAt` continuity together with `coe_linearMapAt_of_mem hb`, for example:

```lean

  refine (e.continuousLinearMapAt R b).continuous.congr (fun y => ?_)
```
